narr: During the afternoon and into the evening strong thunderstorms developed and moved across parts of East Central Colorado. Hail up to nickel size was reported at Stratton and Burlington. Heavy rainfall in the Burlington area caused a culvert to be washed out.
ev: A culvert was washed out from the heavy rainfall.
lsr: A CULVERT WAS WASHED OUT ACCORDING TO THE EMERGENCY MANAGER. TIME OF EVENT ESTIMATED FROM RADAR.
